narr: Broad upper-level troughing with southwesterly flow aloft allowed for deep tropical moisture to remain in place, while a northward lifting frontal boundary became the focus for showers and thunderstorms. Repeated rounds of heavy rainfall over already sufficiently saturated soils resulted in flooding across Palm Beach.
ev: Boynton Beach Police reported that Gateway Boulevard was closed due to flooding near Seacrest Boulevard. Nearby rain gauges measured around 4-5 inches of rain between 7 PM and 11 PM.
